name: Gradient-Based Boundary Classification
aliases: Gradient-Based Boundary Classification — Cell-Diagonal Data Shift, Reflecting Material Classification
definition: A method to classify voxels as 'reflecting' (surface) or 'ambient' (volume) based on the voxel's data value, the gradient magnitude, and the range of field values for the material, departing from using gradient magnitude in isolation.
summary: Gradient-Based Boundary Classification determines if a voxel lies on a material boundary by interpreting gradient magnitude relative to the data value and classification range, rather than relying on gradient magnitude in isolation.
